quote.text: time is fixed for thee, which if thou dost not use for clearing away the clouds from thy mind, it will go and thou wilt go, and it will never return. Every
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Just as time is fleeting, so are the moments you spend with your children—clear away distractions to be present, nurturing their growth with your full attention.
    • By removing the “clouds” from your mind, you model mindfulness and intentionality, teaching your children the value of savoring each precious moment.
  • Leadership:
    • Embrace the certainty of time; lead by example, recognizing that every decision carries the weight of opportunity lost or seized, and cultivate clarity in every choice.
    • In leadership, refining your thoughts and purpose clears the path for your team, fostering an environment where collective focus transforms challenges into growth.
  • Product Management:
    • Time in product management is as finite as the opportunity to innovate; use it to clear away inefficiencies and ambiguities, ensuring your vision remains sharp and actionable.
    • Adopt a mindset of mindful prioritization—eliminate unnecessary distractions from your strategy, and channel your energy into crafting solutions that stand the test of time.
